events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool, England, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon today, who would have been 86. His impact on music and culture remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 2, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed the iconic 'White Album' on the world. What's your favourite track from this double LP masterpiece?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost a true rock legend. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'! Widely considered a pivotal album in their evolution. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, tragically passed away on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Passing
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who we lost 46 years ago. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie was born on January 8, 1947, and would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Bowie's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the extraordinary life and music of David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. A true innovator, forever missed.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Presley was born on January 8, 1935, in Tupelo, Mississippi, and would have been 92 today.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today. His legacy lives on!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page, known for Led Zeppelin, was born on January 9, 1944, and turns 83 today.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist, Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer and songwriter Sir Rod Stewart was born on January 10, 1945, and turns 82 today.

angles.name: Rod the Mod's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Sir Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years. What's your go-to Rod song?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, lead singer of Madness, was born on January 13, 1961, and turns 66 today.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness! Here's to more 'One Step Beyond' years.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English musician, singer, and songwriter Paul Young was born on January 17, 1956, and turns 71 today.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the blue-eyed soul legend, Paul Young! What's your favourite hit from him?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: American country music icon Dolly Parton was born on January 19, 1946, in Tennessee, and turns 81 today.

angles.name: Queen of Country's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend of music and an absolute icon.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and Take That lead vocalist Gary Barlow was born on January 20, 1971, and turns 56 today.

angles.name: Take That Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! What's your favourite track he's penned?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer and songwriter Billy Ocean was born on January 21, 1950, and turns 77 today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Get outta my dreams, get into my car... and play his greatest hits!

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame induction (1989)
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame was held on January 24, 1989.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame Inaugural
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame held its very first induction ceremony. Who was in that inaugural class and who would you induct today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Mark Owen, a member of Take That, was born on January 27, 1972, and turns 55 today.

angles.name: Take That Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! Celebrating the Take That star today. What's your favourite solo track from him?
